Hunt down [[Kasha Blackblood]]'s failed apprentices cowering in [[the Catacombs]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| profession = necromancer
| test = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Enter the catacombs and destroy the [[Blood Fanatic]]s.  
* Destroy [3..0] more Blood Fanatic(s).
* Return to Kasha Blackblood for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Kasha will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
**{{skill icon|Blood Renewal}}
**{{skill icon|Vampiric Touch}}

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

===Environmental changes===
* Accepting this quest temporarily removes the [[Gargoyle]]s and collector [[Karleen]] from the cavern near the [[Green Hills County]] exit. They will start spawning again once the Blood Fanatics are dealt with.

== Walkthrough ==
The fastest route to the fanatics is from [[the Barradin Estate]]. From there, head north following the quest marker, and cross the second bridge near the Catacombs entrance. Inside, go straight east to find the fanatics (see the quest map for reference).

Alternatively, you may map travel to [[Ashford Abbey]] and enter the Catacombs there. There is a hidden passage to the right, just behind [[Necromancer Munne]]. At the end of the cavern, follow the long path straight ahead littered with gargoyles. When the path forks, follow the quest marker to the stairs which lead to a crypt on the right, where the fanatics are located.

The fanatics themselves shouldn't pose any serious threat, dispose of them before returning to Kasha for your reward.

:''"I've got a job for you, if you're willing to work. A group of former students of mine are hiding out in the '''catacombs'''. They fear my wrath, and rightly so. They have failed in their training and they must pay the price. They're very fond of [[Dark Pact]], so you should be able to counter them using '''[[Blood Magic]]''' to drain their Health."''

==Notes==
